end.goal: Any engineer can hand a manufacturer a spec that gets quoted without a phone call.
end.why: Small builders lose weeks to specs that come back with questions. Nobody sells them a physics- and manufacturability-checked spec at a price they will pay.
end.success: Specs produced here are quoted as-is by real manufacturers, and builders come back for a second one.
end.horizon: 2027 — or earlier if quote-ready is proven and someone pays

month.goal: Prove that a finished spec is worth paying for.
